category: inference platform with embedding and rerank APIs, monthly free token allowance

free_tier.stated: Free plan (Toolbox playground): foundation-model tokens up to 300,000 per month; the embeddings and reranking APIs are listed as available on the free Lite plan
free_tier.notes: unverified: no page read says whether embedding and rerank tokens draw down the 300,000 foundation-model tokens; the embedding and reranker models are billed per token on the paid plans. Of the hosted models, slate-125m, slate-30m, all-minilm-l6-v2 and the ms-marco reranker carry a Deprecated mark; granite-embedding-278m-multilingual and multilingual-e5-large do not

tooling: watsonx.ai REST API and Python library with a bearer token from an IBM Cloud API key and a project id; embeddings via the text embeddings method, rerank via the rerank method
chaining: the one account also covers chat models under the same 300,000-token allowance

limits.value: 300,000 foundation-model tokens per month on the Free plan; unverified whether embedding and rerank tokens count against it
a third-party catalogue reports 2 inference requests per second on the Lite plan; unverified at IBM

identity_cost.detail: an IBM Cloud account is needed; IBM's sign-up pages state that email address, personal information and a credit card (used to verify identity) are entered at account creation, with no charge unless the account is upgraded to a billable plan and billable services are consumed; a third-party catalogue reports no payment card for the Lite plan, which IBM's pages contradict

reliability_note: several hosted encoder models are marked Deprecated in the model table, among them the only listed reranker; the documentation gives a withdrawal date of June 8, 2026 for all-minilm-l6-v2
confidence_note: the Free token allowance, the availability of the embeddings and reranking APIs on the Lite plan and the credit-card step of sign-up are quoted from vendor pages; the draw-down of embedding tokens and the rate limit are unverified at the vendor.

evidence.quote: Foundation Models: Up to 300,000 tokens per month
evidence.proved: the Free plan includes up to 300,000 foundation-model tokens per month

evidence.quote: Both watsonx.ai Studio plans provide the following features you can use with unstructured data and to develop generative AI solutions:
evidence.proved: the Lite and Professional plans share the feature list that follows, which includes the embeddings and reranking APIs
the text reranking API is available on the free Lite plan
granite-embedding-278m-multilingual is a hosted embedding model with 512 input tokens and 768 dimensions
multilingual-e5-large is a hosted embedding model with 1,024 dimensions
the listed hosted reranker is ms-marco-minilm-l-12-v2, marked Deprecated, with 512 input tokens

evidence.quote: Rate-limited to 2 inference requests per second, custom foundation models are not available, and you cannot downgrade back to Lite after upgrading.
evidence.proved: a third-party catalogue reports a 2 requests per second inference limit on the Lite plan
a third-party catalogue reports that the Lite plan needs no payment card
IBM's watsonx sign-up page states that the IBM Cloud account behind watsonx asks for a credit card for identity verification
evidence.quote: For your IBM Cloud account, you enter your email address, personal information, and credit card information, which is used to verify your identity.

evidence.proved: IBM Cloud's account FAQ states that creating a new account requires a credit card for identity verification
evidence.quote: For identity verification, a credit card is required when you create a new account.

evidence.proved: the watsonx.ai account setup page states that a credit card is entered to create the account
evidence.quote: You must enter a credit card to create a Pay-As-You-Go IBM Cloud account.

binding_note: 300,000 tokens a month is the stated ceiling, shared at least with foundation-model inference
notes: the plans page was reachable only through a provider-pinned read after the origin answered HTTP 403 to the default read
